answers.note: Atari 2600 оставалась в производстве пятнадцать лет.

literal.prompt: Что позволяло менять игры на домашней Atari 2600, выпущенной в 1977 году?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Strong L204 explicitly says players changed games on2600 by inserting new cartridges. Atari L396 binds VCS/2600 names and L398–L409 places release in1977; Strong L204 independently gives1975 Pong plus two years. This supports key0 without relying on frozen index. But the set fails plausible MEDIUM discrimination: «неизменяемый набор» is self-excluding for «менять игры», while optical discs and network download point to later game-distribution eras. Rejecting those does not require knowledge of Atari2600’s actual mechanism. All are gaming-content mechanisms, yet the date and semantic clue make this an inadequately challenging option row.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Atari VCS, позже названная Atari 2600, использовала сменные игровые картриджи. Пользователь мог покупать новые игры для одной и той же консоли.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Atari L396 directly binds original VCS name to later2600. Strong L204/L209 supports replaceable cartridges and adding games; L205–L206 describes varied software/products. Buying new games for the same machine is the direct consequence of interchangeable software cartridges. Two sentences name the correct method and explain it without claiming Atari invented cartridge media.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Atari 2600 оставалась в производстве пятнадцать лет.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The fifteen-year production duration is true in Strong L206. However, it is a fact about the console’s manufacturing lifespan, with no stated relation to cartridges or their contents/operation/library. It could be attached unchanged to any of the four option rows. The correct option is removable cartridges; an independent console-lifespan fact does not supply the required extra useful fact about that option. Do not mark factual truth as sufficient own-option usefulness.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Анонсированная Atari 800XL включает 25 встроенных игр и рабочий слот для картриджей.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The announcement’s25 built-in games and working cartridge slot are supported at800XL L364/L370–L372. But L364 explicitly calls this a recreation, L392 says modern updates/original, and L368 schedules shipment forApril2027. Current note calls it only «Анонсированная Atari 800XL», omitting the modern-recreation identity; in an original1977 Atari context this can misattribute the25 built-in games to the historical800XL computer. Clarify the actual referent as announced modern recreation THE800XL. Its combination of fixed built-ins and extra cartridge games does not make a fixed unchangeable library a correct2600 answer.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Sony использовала CD-ROM как основной носитель оригинальной PlayStation.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Sony L194 explicitly makes CD-ROM the original PlayStation primary format; L195 contrasts ROM cartridges and CD-ROM distribution, L197 explains commercial role. This is a concrete useful example of the optical-disc alternative. It does not claim Atari2600 had optical media or that Sony invented CDs.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Xbox Live Arcade давала игрокам доступ к играм через сервис Xbox Live.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The retained Xbox press-release narrative L56–L57 says Xbox Live Arcade brought games directly to Xbox via Xbox Live and provided access to arcade titles; L58 mentions downloadable content. This accurately illustrates the network-access alternative without claiming Atari2600 supported that service. The past tense and named service keep it historical.
